# Permission matrix

Source of truth: `packages/shared/src/roles.ts` (enforced by the API, mirrored by the web app for UX only).
Every permission-guarded endpoint is exercised for every role by `apps/api/test/permissions.test.ts`.

## Rules
- **Deny by default.** A route without an explicit permission is either public (listed below) or open to any signed-in user of that college for self-service only.
- **Unverified users** (college verification pending) are limited to: `feed:read`, `roadmaps:read`, `jobs:read`, `content:report`.
- **MFA:** SUPER_ADMIN, COLLEGE_ADMIN have **no** permissions until TOTP is enabled.
- **Capabilities:** `CERTIFIED_CONTRIBUTOR` adds `roadmaps:write` (students only).
- **Tenant overrides:** a college admin may grant or revoke permissions per role; `platform:*` permissions can never be granted to a college role.
- **Escalation guards:** only a college admin can act on another college admin; SUPER_ADMIN cannot be assigned through the college API; the last active college admin cannot be demoted.
- **Super admin** works only on the platform host and sees aggregate counts — never message content.

## Endpoints
| Endpoint | Requires | Host | Rate limit | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/tenant` | public | any | — | Public branding for the college on this subdomain |
| `PUT /api/v1/tenant/branding` | `tenant:branding` | college | adminWrite | Update college branding |
| `GET /api/v1/tenant/settings` | `tenant:settings` | college | — | Features, limits and permission overrides |

| `POST /api/v1/auth/signup` | public | college | signup | Create an account (college verification follows in Phase 2) |

| `POST /api/v1/auth/login` | public | any | login | Sign in with email and password |

| `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` | public | any | refresh | Rotate the refresh cookie and get a new access token |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` | public | any | — | Sign out on this device |
